column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rules for the CI scan of the freshly built image.
# One rule per line, tab-separated: <plugin id>
# Everything not listed keeps the baseline default, which reports the alert
# and, with fail_action on, fails the job. Add an IGNORE only with a written
# reason on the line above it, and prefer fixing the finding in the app.
# Findings from the first scan (run 36517913550) and what was done about them:
#   CSP: style-src unsafe-inline (Medium)        -> fixed: the policy no longer allows inline styles
#   Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy missing (Low)   -> fixed: the header is sent on every response
#   the three informational alerts below         -> accepted, reasons given
# Comments in the app's own unminified JavaScript. They document the code and
# contain no credentials, hostnames or internal paths (Gitleaks covers secrets).
# It is a single-page app. The alert only says that a spider will miss routes
# that JavaScript builds; every route is covered by the browser tests instead.
# Cache headers are deliberate: API responses are private and not storable,
# application modules are revalidated on every load so a deploy cannot leave a
# browser running an old module (see arranger_api.middleware).
